title: Checked Baggage Allowances and Rates for the Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Baggage included in the fare, and the rates charged for what is not included, are scheduled brand by brand across the Air Ticket Fare Brands.

| Fare brand | Checked bags included | First bag (USD) | Second bag (USD) | Overweight (USD per bag) | Oversize (USD per bag) | Cabin bag included |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 0 | 40.00 | 55.00 | 125.00 | 200.00 | no |
| Economy Saver | 0 | 35.00 | 50.00 | 115.00 | 185.00 | yes |
| Economy Classic | 1 | 35.00 | 45.00 | 100.00 | 175.00 | yes |
| Economy Flex | 1 | 30.00 | 45.00 | 100.00 | 175.00 | yes |
| Premium Economy Select | 2 | 30.00 | 45.00 | 90.00 | 150.00 | yes |
| Business Saver | 2 | 30.00 | 40.00 | 75.00 | 125.00 | yes |
| Business Flex | 3 | 30.00 | 40.00 | 75.00 | 125.00 | yes |

## What each column states

The **checked bags included** column states the number of checked bags included in the fare per traveller. The **first bag** and **second bag** columns state the fee for a bag in that position when it is not included. The **overweight** column states the fee per checked bag above the weight allowance and the **oversize** column the fee per checked bag above the size allowance. The **cabin bag** column states whether a full-size cabin bag is included in the fare.

## Notes on the schedule

The allowance takes five values: 0 bags on the two cheapest brands, 1 on Economy Classic and Economy Flex, 2 on Premium Economy Select and Business Saver, and 3 on Business Flex. Basic Economy Lite is the only brand scheduled without a cabin bag.

The first-bag rate never rises above 40.00 USD and never falls below 30.00 USD; the second-bag rate runs from 55.00 USD down to 40.00 USD. The overweight and oversize rates are scheduled as separate lines and each falls as the brand rises, from 125.00 USD and 200.00 USD on Basic Economy Lite to 75.00 USD and 125.00 USD on the two Business brands.

## Hypothetical illustration

On a hypothetical Economy Classic booking the schedule includes 1 checked bag, so a traveller presenting two bags meets the second-bag rate of 45.00 USD for the second of them. On a hypothetical Premium Economy Select booking the schedule includes 2 checked bags, so the same traveller meets neither the first-bag nor the second-bag rate.
